name: eilikrineia-study
description: Replication package for four experiments (6,224 trials) on whether a signed, hash-chained record of a coding agent's own claims changes what it claims and what it delivers. Study 3's preregistered human audit of the completion labeller was not completed; in Study 2, a post hoc audit measured its agreement with two human raters on the same 80 messages. Study 3 has verified external timestamps from before its first trial (three RFC 3161 tokens and OpenTimestamps); the inspection found none for the pilot and Studies 1 and 2, whose plans carry only the signed entry times of the author's ledger (internal timestamps). They first appear in the inspected public ledger history in commit a7a7561 (2026-11-10 15:20:10 UTC), whose first OpenTimestamps file holds only pending attestations; the earliest verified Bitcoin attestation found is block 975319 (2026-11-10), in a later commit; both after those trials. Version 1.1.0 adds exploratory post hoc analyses outside the release seal.
